capabilities: Define regex patterns with URL templates using capture groups
Render matching text as clickable links in Reading View and Live Preview
Enable, disable, edit, reorder, and delete patterns individually
Skip code blocks, inline code, existing links, wikilinks, and frontmatter
disambiguation: Not a link-management or graph tool; it only renders text matching regex rules as clickable links without modifying notes.
extras: Includes troubleshooting guidance and recommends regex101.com for testing patterns.
intentEvidence: similar to GitHub's autolink feature but with full regex support
problem: Obsidian only autolinks plain URLs, so patterns like issue keys, stock tickers, or @mentions stay as plain text instead of linking out.

relations.evidence: similar to GitHub's autolink feature but with full regex support

summary: Rule-based plugin that turns text matching user-defined regex patterns into clickable external links in both Reading View and Live Preview.
